last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered all 30 fresh non-prescription topics; 195 unique PubMed records were fetched and all 195 abstracts were available for inspection. A direct follow-up E-utilities fetch verified PMID 28545353 because the first search ranked a book record ahead of the magnesium CRP meta-analysis. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 36535459, 36342289, 31331553, 38925412, 27047809, 30940490, 34262716, 27806832, 35781715, 26233863, 28545353, 34513905, 34060403, 38553998, 28054937, 30509713, 34760018, 36804260, 24719806, 18952164, 30854952, and 25669317. Twenty-two new entries across twenty-one qualified topics retain numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects; three qualified topics matched existing entries and six topics were screened out because retrieved evidence was protocol-like, involved an unmatched intervention, lacked a usable numeric outcome, or did not provide a verifiable human comparator. One retained PubMed reference was already linked in the database and twenty-one were new.
